model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 12208 North 19th Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona, as the Officer Zane T. Coolidge Post Office.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Abraham Hamadeh (R-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would rename a Phoenix post office located at 12208 North 19th Avenue in honor of Officer Zane T. Coolidge.
